requirement: This code should implement a FUNCTION_BLOCK named FB_CDPlayer with methods to control a CD player's state, track, and volume. The block should have output variables bPlayerActive (BOOL), byVolume (BYTE), and byTrack (UINT). The methods include SetTrack, which takes a UINT input byNewTrack and sets byTrack to this value, returning a BOOL indicating success; SetVolume, which takes a BYTE input byNewVolume and sets byVolume to this value, also returning a BOOL; Start, which sets bPlayerActive to true; and Stop, which sets bPlayerActive to false. Each method should update the state of the CD player and return a BOOL indicating the operation was processed, although the actual implementation of these return values is not specified in the provided snippet.
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个名为 FB_CDPlayer 的 FUNCTION_BLOCK，包含控制 CD 播放器状态、曲目和音量的方法。该块应有输出变量 bPlayerActive（BOOL 类型）、byVolume（BYTE 类型）和 byTrack（UINT 类型）。方法包括 SetTrack，它接受一个 UINT 类型的输入 byNewTrack 并将 byTrack 设置为此值，返回一个表示成功的 BOOL 值；SetVolume，接受一个 BYTE 类型的输入 byNewVolume 并将 byVolume 设置为此值，同样返回 BOOL 值；Start，将 bPlayerActive 设置为 true；以及 Stop，将 bPlayerActive 设置为 false。每个方法应更新 CD 播放器的状态并返回一个 BOOL 值，表示操作已处理，尽管在提供的代码片段中并未具体说明这些返回值的实际实现。
